title: Application of large language models in disease diagnosis and treatment

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Application of large language models in disease diagnosis and treatment》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, and Qwen are emerging as transformative technologies for the diagnosis and treatment of various diseases.

evidence.text: Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, and Qwen are emerging as transformative technologies for the diagnosis and treatment of various diseases.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Application of large language models in disease diagnosis and treatment》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】They can enhance diagnostic accuracy by processing vast amounts of patient data and medical literature and have demonstrated their utility in diagnosing common diseases and facilitating the identification of rare diseases by recognizing subtle patterns in symptoms and test results.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】These models can also assist in treatment planning by suggesting evidence-based interventions and improving clinical decision support systems through integrated analysis of patient records.

evidence.text: They can enhance diagnostic accuracy by processing vast amounts of patient data and medical literature and have demonstrated their utility in diagnosing common diseases and facilitating the identification of rare diseases by recognizing subtle patterns in symptoms and test results.
These models can also assist in treatment planning by suggesting evidence-based interventions and improving clinical decision support systems through integrated analysis of patient records.
